label: sec:categorical-braiding-hecke-eigenbasis-preamble
html: The group algebra of the braid group B_n has infinite rank and cannot support a finite-dimensional trace functional directly. Imposing the quadratic skein relation (\sigma_i - q)(\sigma_i + q^{-1}) = 0 projects the braid action onto the finite-dimensional Iwahori–Hecke algebra H_n(q) of rank n! over \mathbb{Z}[q, q^{-1}]. Within H_n(q), the Kazhdan–Lusztig bar involution \overline{\sigma_i} = \sigma_i^{-1} separates self-dual and anti-self-dual classes, while the Jones–Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M collapses closed braids to a single Laurent rational invariant. Diagonalizing the central Jucys–Murphy operators in H_n(q) produces the knot eigenbasis in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A), which serves as the algebraic basis for all subsequent mass and binding evaluations.
